notes.content:
Improved gameplay!
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27471911/f268da5fa4097d75084fee6bc1c6d6c5e1a42cc8.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27471911/5ce2a3185dd868a667afc5ceac86ea9e7d9a40ab.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27471911/570f112e19d6f335dc0f3fb66c137e97cbfe5418.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27471911/5b3207ef0f420524b850ec7fbe202ca7327ac5e8.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27471911/50ff008c3161508d38b7d5ae3b1bb030b5dcc099.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27471911/0d9ef2c5edd65400853e46d8ff885be921fce10a.jpg[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] Better mobility against the walls
[*] Visually improved racing line, now [b] visible through the walls[/b]!

Have fun!
